easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.
